title: Zesty Fluffy Croatian Lamb Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Croatian dish featuring lamb, tamarind paste, and long fermentation dough, all wrapped in a banana leaf.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb shoulder, tamarind paste, cumin, and paprika.
Knead the long fermentation dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle and place a quarter of the lamb mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the lamb mixture to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place each triangle on a banana leaf and brush with olive oil.
Bake the biryani for 30 minutes or until the dough is golden brown.
While the biryani is baking, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Serve the biryani hot with the sauteed onion and garlic on top.
